eyebrow.zh: 将支持的剪映 draft bundle 解析成多轨模型，用 Python 或 CLI 修改字幕、音频与转场材料。
eyebrow.en: Parse supported Jianying draft bundles into a multitrack model and edit subtitle, audio and transition materials through Python or CLI.

headline.zh:
从工程结构入手，
修改可编辑时间线
headline.en:
Work with the project.
Edit the timeline structure.

sub.zh: 将支持的剪映 draft bundle 解析成多轨模型，用 Python 或 CLI 修改字幕、音频与转场材料。
sub.en: Parse supported Jianying draft bundles into a multitrack model and edit subtitle, audio and transition materials through Python or CLI.

caption.zh: 工程 JSON · 多轨模型

body.zh: 轨道、材料和时间范围保留在 Draft 模型中。
body.en: Tracks, materials and time ranges remain in the Draft model.

body.zh: 字幕与音频接口同时维护材料和 segment。
body.en: Subtitle and audio helpers maintain materials and segments together.

body.zh: 将写回后的模型与预期结构比较。
body.en: Compare the written model with the intended structure.

body.zh: 当修改对象是字幕或配音位置时，只拿到成片很难保留原来的编辑结构。draftseam 提供对 template.tmp 的结构化读取和写回，并把常见字幕、音频和转场操作收进窄接口。是否能在具体剪映版本中打开，仍需对实际工程验证。
body.en: An exported video does not expose the original subtitle and audio structure. draftseam provides structured access to template.tmp and focused helpers for common timeline edits. Opening the result in a particular Jianying version still requires validation with that project.

body.zh: 使用仓库自带的示例 bundle，验证模型 round-trip 相等、字幕材料从 1 变 2、opaque 文件字节不变；没有在剪映/CapCut 应用中重新打开验收。
body.en: The supplied fixture validates model round-trip equality, a subtitle count change from one to two, and unchanged opaque-file bytes. It is not reopened in the Jianying/CapCut application in this demo.

alt.zh: 使用仓库自带的示例 bundle，验证模型 round-trip 相等、字幕材料从 1 变 2、opaque 文件字节不变；没有在剪映/CapCut 应用中重新打开验收。
alt.en: The supplied fixture validates model round-trip equality, a subtitle count change from one to two, and unchanged opaque-file bytes. It is not reopened in the Jianying/CapCut application in this demo.

body.zh: bundle.py 负责目录 I/O，parser.py 与 schema.py 建立允许额外字段的 Draft 模型，agent_api.py 原地修改材料和 segment，writer.py 写回 JSON。draft_info.json 等旁文件视为 opaque 数据，不解密或同步修改。
body.en: bundle.py owns directory I/O; parser.py and schema.py create a Draft model that permits extra fields. agent_api.py mutates materials and segments, and writer.py writes JSON back. Sibling files such as draft_info.json are opaque and are not decrypted or synchronized.

alt.zh: bundle.py 负责目录 I/O，parser.py 与 schema.py 建立允许额外字段的 Draft 模型，agent_api.py 原地修改材料和 segment，writer.py 写回 JSON。draft_info.json 等旁文件视为 opaque 数据，不解密或同步修改。
alt.en: bundle.py owns directory I/O; parser.py and schema.py create a Draft model that permits extra fields. agent_api.py mutates materials and segments, and writer.py writes JSON back. Sibling files such as draft_info.json are opaque and are not decrypted or synchronized.

body.zh: 它处理工程结构，渲染与应用内兼容性由剪辑软件负责。修改真实工程前请保留副本；本工具的一代 .bak 不等于完整版本管理。
body.en: It handles project structure; rendering and application compatibility belong to the editor. Keep a project copy before real edits; a one-generation .bak is not full version control.

alt.zh: 它处理工程结构，渲染与应用内兼容性由剪辑软件负责。修改真实工程前请保留副本；本工具的一代 .bak 不等于完整版本管理。
alt.en: It handles project structure; rendering and application compatibility belong to the editor. Keep a project copy before real edits; a one-generation .bak is not full version control.

body.zh: CLI 修改 template.tmp 并备份上一代，不更新 opaque 加密文件。
body.en: The CLI updates template.tmp and backs up one generation; opaque encrypted files are not updated.

note.zh: 使用仓库自带的示例 bundle，验证模型 round-trip 相等、字幕材料从 1 变 2、opaque 文件字节不变；没有在剪映/CapCut 应用中重新打开验收。
note.en: The supplied fixture validates model round-trip equality, a subtitle count change from one to two, and unchanged opaque-file bytes. It is not reopened in the Jianying/CapCut application in this demo.

body.zh: 读取 3 条轨道及材料列表。
body.en: Read the three tracks and material lists.

body.zh: 在临时副本中新增字幕，核对模型与 opaque 文件。
body.en: Add a subtitle in a temporary copy and check the model and opaque file.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。以下演示只在本地解析 JSON，并在临时副本中写入。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. The demo parses JSON locally and writes only to a disposable copy.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/draftseam.git
cd draftseam
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

python -m draftseam.cli inspect tests/fixtures/sample_project
python examples/presentation_demo.py

limitations.zh: 只验证了自带 fixture，不能声称所有剪映版本或字段都无损兼容。
limitations.en: The fixture does not establish lossless compatibility with every Jianying version or field.

limitations.zh: 不解密 draft_info，不渲染视频。
limitations.en: The tool neither decrypts draft_info nor renders video.

limitations.zh: 转场材料的存在不保证应用已将其连接到片段。
limitations.en: A transition material does not prove it is attached to clips in the editor.
